title: Halftone Dot Gradient
description: Classic newspaper printmaking halftone screen with dots scaling along an optical gradient.
designRules:
# Design System

Genre: Retro
Macrostructure: Full Bleed
Density: Medium
Shape: Pill
Motion: None
Typography: Condensed
Color: Monochrome

## Rules

- Passive Print Backdrop: the interaction model is part of the design, not an add-on.
- Reduced motion replaces animation with a state change; nothing is hidden behind motion.
- The component composes through `cn` and never hardcodes colours.

## Avoid

- Reskinning this resource and republishing it under a new name.
- Adding shadows or radii that contradict its shape language.
